features: Local exclusive O_CREAT|O_EXCL-like lock via Rust create_new
JSON Lines canonical ordered SHA-256 hash chaining
Append plus file fsync, parent directory sync, full recovery readback
Replay checks for event, capture, nonce, review and payload digest
Recovery rejects torn tail, corrupted JSON, invalid sequence or hash link
limitations: Local filesystem lock ownership is not authenticated process-liveness fencing
Append writes can leave torn tail after a crash: recovery fails closed and requires external recovery procedure
Replay ledger is local and not independently externally anchored or replicated
Physical source identity and custody remain unauthenticated
